take: Carolina announced that Seth Jarvis was activated from injured reserve, Skyler Brind'Amour was recalled from Chicago (AHL), and Bradly Nadeau was assigned to Chicago. Nadeau had played second-line minutes (14:07 a night) but had no goals and two assists in three games, and Carolina controlled 46% of the 5-on-5 expected goals (a measure of chance quality) with him on the ice. That is 14 points worse than without him. Carolina is 8-2-1 and holds 62% of expected goals overall, so the roster stays strong.
